US_CL10_U1.question: Welche Kundengruppen bringen den meisten Nettoerlös?
US_CL10_U1.final_response_text: Es scheint, dass es keine Daten gibt, die den Nettoerlös nach Kundengruppen aufschlüsseln. US_CL10_U1.sql_query:
SELECT cd.customer_desc AS Kundengruppe, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS Nettoerlös
FROM public.customer_customer_demo ccd
JOIN public.customer_demographics cd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON ccd.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY Nettoerlös DESC
LIMIT 5;
